capabilities.description: Beekeepers can register apiaries and hives they own, list them and view the status of each hive.
capabilities.name: Apiary and hive registry

capabilities.description: Beekeepers can record and validate hive inspections and view inspection history. Hives with high mite counts are flagged as needing varroa treatment until they are treated and a later inspection is back at or under the threshold.
capabilities.name: Hive inspection and varroa monitoring

capabilities.description: Keeps a catalogue of treatment products and lets hive owners record treatments on their hives and look up treatment history.
capabilities.name: Hive treatment management

capabilities.description: Owners can record and list harvests from their hives. A harvest is refused while a treatment or its withdrawal period is still running.
capabilities.name: Honey harvest recording with food-safety withdrawal checks

capabilities.description: Hive scales are linked to hives. A sudden weight loss is treated as a suspected swarm, and a scheduled SMS alert is sent to the beekeeper. Repeat alerts can be suppressed.
capabilities.name: Swarm detection and SMS alerting

capabilities.description: Builds a quarterly report of beekeeping activity for a region, using hive data and the date window of the quarter.
capabilities.name: Quarterly regional beekeeping reporting

capabilities.description: Business rule breaches are reported in a consistent way: invalid data, missing resources, actions by someone who is not the owner, and conflicting operations.
capabilities.name: Business rule violation signalling
